dict.string: ALWith U⁺ uses your microphone to transcribe speech into the chat input and for voice calls with Codex.
ALWith U⁺ uses the camera for video calls and visual tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ reads contacts only when a task needs to identify people you mention.
ALWith U⁺ reads calendars only for scheduling and meeting tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ reads reminders only for tasks you explicitly connect to them.
ALWith U⁺ reads photos only for image tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ reads Apple Music only for music tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ controls other apps only when you ask it to perform a computer task.
ALWith U⁺ reads the Desktop only for files used by tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ reads Documents only for projects and files you open.
ALWith U⁺ reads Downloads only for files used by tasks you start.
ALWith U⁺ uses the local network only for devices and services you connect.
ALWith U⁺ uses Bluetooth only for devices you connect.
ALWith U⁺ uses location only for tasks that need local context.
